authorization_basis: The user explicitly authorized continuing from the verified five-experiment blind run to development-only outcome scoring.

human_fallback_contract.evaluation_partition: Within each Monte Carlo replicate, freeze one stratified random third of every arm as the evaluation set for every nonzero budget; draw all pilot samples from the other two thirds.
human_fallback_contract.zero_human_rule: Humans-only selects the declared control arm; both synthetic-plus-human policies reduce exactly to the frozen synthetic recommendation.
human_fallback_contract.synthetic_plus_intelligent_humans_alloca: one participant per arm, then allocate the remainder alternately to the frozen synthetic top-two arms; sample randomly within arm
human_fallback_contract.fusion_rule: For each arm, combine its frozen synthetic mean as 10 pseudo-observations with the pilot human mean and actual pilot count; never tune the pseudo-count.
human_fallback_contract.evaluation_rule: Select using pilot data only and compute regret on the fixed disjoint evaluation third with the task's frozen primary weighting rule.

post_reveal_protocol_correction.reason: The first generated fallback artifact changed the evaluation remainder as budget increased, confounding budget comparisons. The corrected scorer freezes one disjoint evaluation third per replicate across every nonzero budget; two thirds remain available so the prespecified 250-person intelligent allocation remains feasible.
post_reveal_protocol_correction.outcome_independence: The correction changes no simulator recommendation, outcome contract, utility, arm set, human allocation policy, fusion rule, or reported task result; it only holds the evaluation target fixed across budgets.

claim_boundary: These five experiments provide development evidence and a complete prospective demonstration. They do not constitute a canonical held-out test or support a general trust-model claim.
